GlobalVariables.StudyDescription: This file contains the metadata, events, and data for REDCap project "Pedigree Editor example: family registry".

ItemDef.Name: pedigree_diagram
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Draw the family here. Link each person to their row on the Family members form.

Question.TranslatedText: Are the participant's biological parents related to each other by blood?

ItemDef.Name: adopted
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Answer yes if this person was adopted into or out of the family.

ItemDef.Name: carrier_status
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Leave blank if this person is not affected and not a known carrier.

Question.TranslatedText: Has this person had ADA2 testing (genetic or enzyme)?

ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Not shown in the pedigree editor: this field has no @PEDIGREE_FIELD tag.

ItemData.Value: Illustrative example family. Both parents are carriers; Maya and her brother Leo have two variants.
Recurrent fevers and rash from age 3. Started a TNF inhibitor at diagnosis.
Tested after his sister's diagnosis. No symptoms so far; reviewed yearly.
Had strokes in his fifties; never tested.
Diagnosed at 24 after a stroke. Awaiting assessment for stem cell transplant.
Adopted into the family as a baby.
